ranked_holds.difficulty: Extended genealogical registers change from universal ancestry to tribal, Levitical, and post-exilic registries; list boundaries can be overfragmented.
ranked_holds.required_review: Require register-function and name-series review; no etymological/root inference.

ranked_holds.difficulty: Ark transport, Uzzah episode, reordered procession, and attributed thanksgiving song move among narrative, ritual, and liturgy.
ranked_holds.required_review: Keep cause/action/consequence and song frame; test embedded-poetry endpoint.

ranked_holds.difficulty: Census, judgment, altar-site notice, and temple-preparation speeches form a transition whose parallel account differs in scope.
ranked_holds.required_review: Compare internal parallel context only; no harmonization or theological motive as boundary authority.

ranked_holds.difficulty: Assembly, Davidic charge, offering register, prayer, accession, and death notice include multiple speeches and closure signals.
ranked_holds.required_review: Preserve speech and response units; check whether colophon belongs with assembly closure.
